title: STMicroelectronics and Hitachi SH-4 CPU Core Architecture, ADCS 7182230F
facts: LDS Rm,FPSCR is an FPU instruction; the manual specifies FPU-disabled exceptions before the register update.
STS FPSCR and FMOV are also subject to FPU disable state; prior context evidence covers those forms.
implementation_policy: Reached native/original-model guard returns existing authored host status -4 before the faulting instruction's side effect. This does not implement physical trap delivery. Successful VBlank lifecycle tests use enabled FPU and test actual copied vectors, context and RTE separately.
